segments.text: My Lordis, I beleve thare be none so unwyse hear, that will mak merchandise with ane Frenche man, or any other unknawin stranger, except he know and understand first the conditioun or promeise maid by the French man or stranger. So lyikwyse I wold that we understood what thing we promeis in the name of the infante unto God in Baptisme: For this caus, I beleve, ye have Confirmatioun.
Then said Maister Bleiter, chaplen, that he had the Devill within him, and the spreit of errour. Then answered him a cheild, saying, "The Devill cane not speik such wordis as yonder man doith speik."
